# betterado_git_repository_branch (Resource)

Manages a Git repository branch in Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

resource "betterado_git_repository" "example" {
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "ExampleRepo"

  initialization {
    init_type = "Clean"
  }
}

resource "betterado_git_repository_branch" "example" {
  repository_id = betterado_git_repository.example.id
  name          = "feature/my-branch"
  ref_branch    = "refs/heads/main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the branch (short format, without refs/heads/ prefix).
- `repository_id` (String) The ID of the Git repository.

### Optional

- `ref_branch` (String) The branch name to branch from (mutually exclusive with ref_tag and ref_commit_id).
- `ref_commit_id` (String) The commit ID to branch from (mutually exclusive with ref_branch and ref_tag).
- `ref_tag` (String) The tag name to branch from (mutually exclusive with ref_branch and ref_commit_id).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_commit_id` (String) The commit ID of the last commit on this branch.
